task_instance: Build a reusable shell script (with --help, HF_TOKEN auth support) that fetches trending Hugging Face models from https://huggingface.co/api/models and outputs JSON, then test it against the live API.
blocker_detail: The sandbox's egress proxy rejects all outbound HTTPS connections to huggingface.co with a 403 on the CONNECT tunnel ('gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)'), confirmed via curl and via $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status which lists huggingface.co:443 under recentRelayFailures as connect_rejected. Per the proxy's own README, this is an organization egress-policy denial that must be reported, not worked around. This blocks the skill's core required steps: investigating the live API response shape (curl .../.well-known/openapi.json, curl .../api/models) and testing the non-destructive script against the real API before handing it to the user, as SKILL.md mandates ('Investigate the shape of the API results before commiting to a final design', 'Non-destructive scripts should be tested before handing over to the User').
evidence: curl -sS -m 10 https://huggingface.co/api/models?limit=3 -> curl: (56) CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403. curl $HTTPS_PROXY/__agentproxy/status showed recentRelayFailures entries with host 'huggingface.co:443', kind 'connect_rejected', detail 'gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial or upstream failure)'. Wrote a working script hf_trending_models.sh (chmod +x) at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec/huggingface__skills__huggingface-tool-builder/hf_trending_models.sh that supports --help and optional HF_TOKEN auth header; ./hf_trending_models.sh --help produced correct usage text, but ./hf_trending_models.sh 3 failed with the same curl exit code 56 (CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403), so the script's actual HTTP call to the Hugging Face API could not be exercised or verified end-to-end.
